children: SCHOLASTIC CORP reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $216.8M, a slight decline from $225.6M a year earlier, and a net loss of $71.2M, or diluted EPS of ($3.77).
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by core product improvements and higher volume, though overall sales were down mid-single digits year-over-year.
Significant channel shift toward direct-to-consumer and e-commerce reduced reliance on traditional retail partners.
New marketing campaigns and product refreshes increased brand awareness and repeat purchase rates.
Expanded production capacity and automated distribution shortened lead times and improved fulfillment.
Management reiterated full-year growth targets and plans continued investment in digital channels and supply-chain resilience.
